entries.height_guide_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. Input image is the exact albedo and geometry reference. Preserve its square framing, both wheel track paths around x=30% and x=70%, every clearly visible medium stone location, direction and edge continuation. Translate material geometry into grayscale height: neutral midgray ground, very shallow broad lowered wheel tracks, existing medium pebbles gently raised with soft domed tops. The stones keep their positions; remove all color and all baked illumination and cast shadows. Distinguish pigment and dark shading from geometric depth. No new stones, no new tracks, no deep trenches. Keep tiny gravel below the resolution of the final 512x512 output quiet, without salt-and-pepper noise. The output is a HEIGHT GUIDE, not a purple normal map: higher=brighter, lower=darker, gentle low contrast. No light direction, border, text, objects or crop. Preserve the original edge structure; do not invent a different seamless composition.

entries.height_guide_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. Input image is the exact painted stucco albedo reference. Preserve the exact square crop, all visible fissure positions, plaster patch boundaries and edge continuation. Make a mostly neutral midgray smooth plane with only shallow gently rounded stucco relief and existing hairline cracks depressed slightly. Remove color, lighting, cast shadow and dirt stain contrast. Large peach/brown color variations are paint or dirt and MUST NOT become bumps or depressions. Avoid exaggerated rough rock, cliffs, pits and isolated grains. The output is a HEIGHT GUIDE, not a normal map: brighter is higher, darker is lower. Gentle low contrast, quiet broad plaster forms, no fine noisy sparkling relief. No added seams, new cracks, border, text, objects, crop or rotation. Preserve the original edge structure.

entries.height_guide_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. The input is an EXACT 8 by 8 checker tile floor albedo. Preserve its square framing, the exact 8x8 layout and every thin joint at x/y multiples of 1/8 including border joints. Both BLACK and CREAM tile faces MUST become the SAME uniform light-midgray height; their color difference is printed pigment and MUST NOT become alternating height. Lower only the narrow grout lines to a dark-midgray shallow groove, with very narrow softly rounded bevels along the exact visible tile edges. Preserve exact border continuation.

entries.height_guide_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. Input is the EXACT vertical wood panel albedo. Preserve square framing, all 13 vertical board strips and their exact narrow joint positions, original knot locations and edge continuation. Convert all differently colored board faces to approximately the SAME quiet midgray height; the orange/brown colors are wood pigment, not raised planks. Lower the existing thin vertical joints gently; give the edges a narrow soft roundover. Add only extremely weak lengthwise fiber relief and a very subtle rounded grain change at original knots. Do not turn every dark knot or fiber into a hole. Remove all color, directional illumination, shadows and stains. Output a low-contrast grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE, NOT a normal map: higher=brighter, lower=darker. No extra planks, no changed board width, no new knots, no wide trenches, no crop, no rotation, no border or text. Preserve the original pattern including top/bottom grain differences.

entries.height_guide_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. Input is the EXACT red diamond-tufted vinyl albedo. Preserve square framing, exact diagonal seam paths, all button center positions and all partial buttons at image boundaries. Button centers are at (0,0),(256,0),(512,0),(128,128),(384,128),(0,256),(256,256),(512,256),(128,384),(384,384),(0,512),(256,512),(512,512) in a 512x512 coordinate system. Translate geometry only: each existing diamond cushion is a broad softly rounded raised dome, each existing stitched seam is a narrow shallow lowered channel, button centers are lowered dimples (even if their visible cap color looks bright). Keep the two axes and all edge continuations exact. Remove red pigment, lighting and baked shadow. Leather grain is effectively flat or extremely subtle to avoid sparkle. Output smooth low-contrast grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE, not a normal map: brighter=raised, darker=lower. No new buttons, no different quilting, no text, border, crop, rotation or cast shadows.
